home.tagline: Speak a paragraph, get a handwritten page — for cards, letters, journals and social posts
home.footerNote: Speech recognition is provided by your browser (Web Speech API). Desktop Chrome / Edge recommended; your text never leaves your device.

home.sampleText:
Dear friend,
see these words: I spoke to a web page and they became handwriting. Type, talk, or import audio — then export as an image or PDF. Have a lovely day.

printable.title: Printable Paper Generator
printable.intro: Free printable lined, graph and handwriting paper. Pick a style, download as PDF and print at home — Letter and A4.
printable.seoTitle: Free printable lined paper — no watermark, no signup
printable.seoText: Every style prints edge-to-edge at exact real-world dimensions (Letter and A4), with no watermark and no account required. Pair it with our handwriting tool: print the paper, or let the generator write on it for you.

tracing.title: Name Tracing Worksheet Generator
tracing.intro: Type a name, get a tracing worksheet: one dark example row, then traceable rows on 3-line handwriting paper. Free PDF, perfect for homeschool and classroom.
tracing.seoTitle: Free name tracing worksheets for homeschool and classroom
tracing.seoText: Personalized tracing sheets are one of the most effective ways to teach handwriting: the child follows the example row, then repeats. Generate as many as you need — each PDF prints at exact letter size with no watermark.
